noun_definition: Distance refers to the measurement of travel between waypoints that users input when submitting an expense in the workspace chat feature.
Waypoint refers to a specific location inputted by the user when submitting a distance expense, which can be deemed invalid if it does not meet the required criteria.
Request refers to the action of submitting a distance expense that fails due to the presence of invalid waypoints.
Failure refers to the unsuccessful submission of a distance expense request after entering an invalid waypoint.
